comment: Written from the maker's own source at commit 7dc3dab, "Update version and changelog", which is the commit that set the installed version 2.0.1; the nine commits after it in the repository still carry 2.0.1 but post-date the library release, and one of them changes ChowChorus filter behaviour at low sample rates, so they were deliberately not read. Also read: doc/manual.md in the same tree, the maker's own ChowTape plugin manual at chowdsp.com/manuals/ChowTapeManual.pdf for the five tape modules, and a render of every panel. Every number quoted in these entries is either a literal in that source or worked out from literals in it. Five modules carry an Oversampling submenu, which changes CPU cost and aliasing rather than the controls; the defaults are 4x on ChowTape and 2x on ChowDer, Werner and Warp. Four modules carry a Publication item that opens the paper the module implements. One conflict with the maker's own manual was found: the manual says ChowDer's Bass and Treble knobs drive a Baxandall EQ circuit, and in this version they drive a first-order shelving filter at 600Hz instead; the Baxandall wave digital filter is in the tree and compiled but never instantiated.
